meta.name: Product Agent Canonical Taxonomy
meta.architecture: L1 domain -> L2 family -> L3 stable product category
design_principles: Taobao/Tmall commercial category framework is the primary coverage backbone.
JD categories supplement missing or more granular stable product categories.
Every L2 and L3 node has exactly one canonical parent.
L3 is a stable product category, not a SKU, marketing phrase, or product model.
Aliases normalize platform naming differences; cross-domain attributes belong to future attribute tags, not duplicate taxonomy parents.
The absence of an exact L3 category never blocks generation; open-world semantic resolution remains mandatory.

source_notes.Taobao/Tmall: Alibaba/Tmall official public category/publication pages provide broad category coverage; user-provided Taobao navigation structure is used as the hierarchy pattern.
source_notes.JD: JD public category/channel pages supplement L2/L3 commodity categories and alternate naming.
